title: The All Regional Directors,
content:
N-15012/3/2026-P and D I/4271296/2026

N-15012/3/2026-P&D            Date: 18-08-2026

To
The All Regional Directors,
Employees’ State Insurance Corporation

Subject: Ensuring provision of ESI Medical Services in Mining
Areas consequent upon implementation of the Code on
Social Security, 2020 – reg.

Sir/Madam,

I am directed to refer to the subject cited above and to state that,
consequent upon implementation of the Code on Social Security,
2020, necessary action is required to ensure that the beneﬁts of the
ESI Scheme are extended to establishments/employees covered
under Chapter IV of the Code, in accordance with the provisions of
the Code and notifications issued thereunder.

In this regard, it is requested that the availability of ESI medical
facilities to mines in the implemented areas under your jurisdiction
(in co-ordination with the SROs) may be reviewed and necessary
action taken, if required, to create additional medical infrastructure /
arrangement, in co-ordination with the Medical Services Division of
the HQ office.

This issues with the approval of the competent authority.

Yours faithfully,

Fateh Chand
ASSISTANT DIRECTOR

Copy to:
1. The Medical Services Division, ESIC Headquarters – for
information and necessary assistance for strengthening of ESI
medical services in mining areas.
2. Medical Commissioners(All zones) for necessary action.
3. Insurance Commissioner(All zones) for information.
